lessons.trigger_condition: The V400/V401 verified autonomy and screen-neural stack was available through `main evolve`, but the installed 23:00 KST tablet scheduler only checked and applied main updates. On UP_TO_DATE days, new verified market/runtime evidence therefore did not automatically enter the bounded learning, capability selection, meta-neural and adaptive-screen decision cycle.
lessons.prevention_rule: After each daily scheduler update check, run one bounded autonomy cycle only after the active runtime manifest compiles and the V400 self-test succeeds. Reuse the existing verified V400 entrypoint, record a separate autonomy status/log, return failures visibly, and preserve fail-closed model/policy retention plus all source-code, arbitrary-command, Git-write, fact-invention and verification-bypass prohibitions.
validation_required: the only sync-watched functional path changed by the candidate is TABLET_SCHEDULED_UPDATE.sh
each scheduled run performs update reconciliation before the autonomy cycle and scheduler reconciliation after it
autonomy execution is gated by tablet_runtime_manifest.py --check --compile
autonomy execution is gated by tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py --self-test
the runtime call reuses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py --domain tablet_gpt --execute-safe-learning --apply-capabilities --train-meta --apply-skills
UP_TO_DATE days still execute one bounded autonomy cycle so fresh verified data can update priorities and UI policy
autonomy failures are recorded separately and preserve the existing policy/model through fail-closed controller behavior
the scheduler contains no git push and gains no source-code generation, arbitrary-command or direct-main-write authority
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V405 schedules only the already allowlisted and verified autonomy entrypoint. It does not grant source-code generation/rewrite, arbitrary command generation, Git/main writes, verification bypass, market-direction invention, card fact invention, precise-location persistence, or user-behavior tracking.
